posts.text: When there wasn’t a nominee, there could not be an AD after 210 days. However, the moment that Schwartz was nominated, the whole thing reset and Jay *could be AD. That is why I asked HHS for clarification and they said that he had not been elevated to AD. They simply chose not to let him.
